Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Treatment-naive postmenopausal women
  -  Diagnosed hypertension (grade 1 or 2 according to ESH/ESC 2013 guidelines)
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  breast cancer in a first-degree relative
  -  hyperplasia diagnosed by endometrial biopsy,
  -  history of thromboembolic diseases,
  -  current  [OR] or history of use of estrogen-progestin therapy  [OR] or contraceptives
  -  diabetes,
  -  kidney failure,
  -  thyroid disease,
  -  heart  [OR] and other chronic diseases (secondary hypertension, [OR]  atrial fibrillation)
